capabilities: Explain selected terms with an AI model in a dedicated entry tab
Navigate related concepts recursively as wikilinks
Display explored concepts and their directional links in a force-directed sidebar graph
Export the explored knowledge base as Markdown notes with frontmatter and a master MOC index
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; some UI labels appear in Chinese (e.g. filter/color/appearance settings and export folder names).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get AI explanations of terms or automatically discover and record relationships between concepts while researching.

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible API endpoint (API Base URL, API Key, and model)

summary: AI concept explorer that explains selected terms like Wikipedia entries, maps their relationships in a sidebar graph, and exports the exploration as notes.
